explanation: Improve the lower bound F(N) ≥ N^{1/2} + O(1) for infinitely many N. It is encoded as an answer with answer(N) − √N → ∞ and F(N) ≥ answer(N) frequently. F(N) is the largest Sidon subset of [N], via maxSidonSubsetCard. This is a faithful rendering of "break the O(1) barrier for infinitely many N".
